title: feat: async dosing calculation pipeline
body: Moves dosing calculation to a redis-backed async worker pool. Part of dosing engine v2 work. Closes MED-405.

title: feat: EHR integration hooks for dosing engine v2
body: Adds EHR write-back hooks for computed doses, reuses the v2 job queue. Closes MED-408.

title: feat: scheduling sync progress indicator (frontend)
body: Websocket-driven progress indicator for the scheduling sync panel. Closes MED-401.

title: chore: dosing engine v2 QA fixes
body: Small fixes found during the clinical QA pass in MED-410 (dosing bands up to 40kg only).

title: docs: update dosing engine API docs for v2
body: Updates internal integration docs to reflect the new dosing engine v2 endpoints.

title: fix: dosing engine v2 paediatric rounding above 40kg
body: Fixes the paediatric dosing table lookup so patients above 40kg use the correct rounding band instead of falling through to the adult table. Should fix MED-412 (dosing engine v2 miscalculates paediatric doses above 40kg). Tested locally against synthetic paediatric patient profiles up to 90kg, still need clinical safety sign-off before merging. Holding on merge until clinical safety review completes - do not want to re-announce this as fixed until it is verified.

title: scheduling sync occasionally stuck at 99%
body: Cosmetic bug, sync actually completes fine but the UI progress bar sticks at 99% for a few seconds before jumping to done.

title: fix: scheduling sync progress bar stuck at 99%
body: Fixes off-by-one in the sync progress event emitter. Closes #289.

title: add audit trail for manual dosing overrides
body: See MED-415. Need to log clinician, patient encounter id, override reason and timestamp for every manual dosing override.

title: dosing audit log for HIPAA / 21 CFR Part 11 prep
body: See MED-395. Need actor, patient encounter reference, dosing value and timestamp for every calculation.

title: test: fix flaky dosing_v2_integration_test
body: Adds a small sleep + retry around the async job assertion. Underlying race was in the test fixture, not product code. See MED-398.

title: better error messages on dosing safety-check failure
body: See MED-407. A silent block on an unsafe dose is not actionable for clinicians.

title: chore: add manual double-check banner for paediatric doses above 40kg
body: Small mitigation while MED-412 is in progress - surfaces a manual double-check banner to clinicians for the affected weight band. Not a real fix.

title: sales demo environment is stale
body: See MED-430. Demo data hasn't been refreshed since v1, doesn't showcase v2 features well.

title: fix: slow scheduling sync queries
body: Adds a missing index that the tuesday migration should have included. See MED-413.

title: clinical validation at scale after MED-412 fix
body: Follow-up validation task once #288 lands. See MED-433.
